# FlowBuddy

> FlowBuddy is an application intelligence layer for SaaS products. A founder shows FlowBuddy their product once (a recorded demo); FlowBuddy learns how the software works — its workflows, its concepts, its screens — and turns that into a founder-approved intelligence layer embedded in the product with one script tag. That single layer powers an in-app AI assistant, contextual guidance, interactive onboarding, and (in beta) AI agent execution. Live in about 30 minutes, no coding required.

Key facts:

- The positioning, in one line: FlowBuddy learns how your software works and turns that knowledge into an intelligence layer for your users and AI agents.
- Everything answers only from knowledge the founder recorded and approved. The assistant shows the source behind every answer and honestly says "I don't know yet" instead of guessing when something isn't covered.
- It is context-aware: it knows which page the user is on and can highlight the exact next step directly in the product's interface.
- Four live capabilities, named on the page as: **In-App AI Assistant** (conversational help inside the product), **Contextual Guidance** (reads the page the user is on and highlights their next step), **Interactive Onboarding** (guides a user through a whole task, one step at a time), and **AI Agent Execution** — in BETA: the assistant carries out an approved workflow itself, but only when the founder has switched it on (off by default) and only with the end user's explicit consent; runs are narrated, stoppable at any time, and outcome-verified before reporting done.
- The homepage states this as "Record once. Power every surface.": one recording produces one approved application-intelligence layer — workflows (how it's done), concepts (what things are), screens (where users are) — and every capability reads from it. In development and NOT yet available, named on the page as: **Autogenerated Help Portal**, **SOP Generation**, and **Third-Party Agent Access** (outside AI agents reading the approved knowledge).
- Setup: record a product demo with the FlowBuddy Chrome recorder → FlowBuddy automatically creates product knowledge and step-by-step workflows → the founder reviews and approves them → embed one small script tag to go live.
- Works with any web app. The assistant is a floating overlay and never changes the host product's pages or layout. Its accent color can match the host brand.
- Privacy and safety: sensitive data is masked in the browser during recording before anything is uploaded; the embed key is public-safe, restricted to allowlisted domains, and rotatable. In agent runs, sensitive values are always typed by the user directly into the product's own fields — they never pass through FlowBuddy.
- Pricing: free during early access; no credit card required.
- Outcomes it is bought for: in-app user assistance, faster onboarding, higher activation, fewer support tickets.

## Pages

- [Home](https://flowbuddyai.com/): the application intelligence layer — the transformation (your product → workflows learned → structured intelligence → users + AI agents) · what the layer is (a new layer in the SaaS stack, above data → API → UI: it understands workflows, guides users, delivers support, drives analytics, and powers AI agents) · "Record once. Power every surface." — one layer and the seven consumers it feeds, four live (one in beta) and three in development · how it works (record → approve → go live) · outcomes · FAQ
- [In-App AI Assistant](https://flowbuddyai.com/in-app-ai-assistant): the assistant capability in depth — grounded answers inside the product, sources shown, honest "I don't know yet"
- [Contextual Guidance](https://flowbuddyai.com/contextual-guidance): the guidance capability in depth — page- and screen-aware help that highlights the next step in the product's own UI
- [Interactive Onboarding](https://flowbuddyai.com/interactive-onboarding): the onboarding capability in depth — guided walkthroughs derived from a recording, advancing automatically across pages
- [AI Agent Execution](https://flowbuddyai.com/ai-agent-execution): the acting capability in depth — IN BETA: consented, narrated, stoppable, outcome-verified runs; off by default
- [FAQ](https://flowbuddyai.com/faq): the full question set — what FlowBuddy AI is, what an application intelligence layer is, and how it differs from chatbots, help centers and product tours; how it learns a product from one recording; setup and installation; accuracy, recording privacy and data handling; support-ticket, onboarding and activation impact; AI agent execution (beta) and where third-party agent access is heading
- [The road ahead](https://flowbuddyai.com/future): FlowBuddy's direction — the same approved intelligence layer opened to more consumers: a hosted help portal and third-party AI-agent access are in development (not yet available)
